description: Send one finding from get_today to the brand's own Meta ad account as a PAUSED campaign and ad set, so you can finish and switch it on yourself in Ads Manager. Nothing spends. Only findings marked draftable can be sent. Only use this when the user has clearly asked for it, and pass confirm true. Without confirm it returns a preview and sends nothing.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the user explicitly asked to send this draft.

daily_budget_usd.description: Daily budget saved on the paused draft. It does not spend until you switch the draft on.

item_key.description: The key of a draftable finding from get_today (fatigue, creative_copy, placement or lookalike).

name: send_paused_draft
